main.description: Compose a 3D scene for a manga panel via kami-mangaka-scene + LangGraph Pregel (compose_scene_3d). Inputs reference an existing panel (kind=panel in vertex_mangaka). Pipeline: load_panel_plan → resolve_assets → pose_characters → place_scene → cinematography → simulate → render_keyframes → critique_and_select → persist. ADR-2605141200.

panelRkey.description: rkey of the panel vertex (kind='panel') to compose.

refineFromRkey.description: Optional rkey of a prior vertex_mangaka_scene_3d row to refine from (re-runs cinematography + render only).

maxIter.description: Max cinematography→render→critique iterations before accepting best score (default 3).

simSeed.description: Deterministic seed for spring-bone / cloth / particle simulation (default 0).

renderAngles.description: Number of alternate camera angles to render per iteration (default 3).

sceneRkey.description: rkey of the persisted vertex_mangaka_scene_3d row.

blobKey.description: Content-addressed SHA-256 hex of the base PNG render (blobs/{repo}/{sha256hex}).

score.description: 7-axis vision critique score (0.0–1.0, sum of composition / silhouette / characterRecognizability / framing / mangaShotGrammar / lightingDrama / actionClarity).

angle.description: Manga shot grammar tag: FullShot / MediumShot / Closeup / OverShoulder / Dutch / BirdsEye / WormsEye.
